messages.subject: Mining & Resources Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Bernard,

Zenith Search's work across mining, industrial services and international leadership is closely aligned with my background. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, leading government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am exploring Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, resources and energy where responsible development and institutional trust are central to execution. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
